workItems.title: Make installer and updater verified, transactional, and recoverable
workItems.rationale: The published installer configuration and public GUI claims diverge; prerequisite downloads lack integrity checks; archive selection can be wrong; pull failure can be ignored; updates are non-atomic and have no rollback.
implementationScope: Align GUI/CLI/TUI claims with shipped configuration
Implement or remove prerequisite detection/download claims
Use secure unique staging paths and content-aware extraction
Verify hashes/signatures before extraction
Propagate fetch/pull/configure/build errors
Stage, verify, atomically activate, rollback and recover interruptions
Generate install manifest and remove nonexistent refs
acceptanceCriteria: Tampered download, failed pull/build, wrong archive, or interruption never replaces working install
Fresh install, upgrade, downgrade policy, rollback, repair, and uninstall pass on clean supported hosts
Capabilities match documentation exactly
Only signed artifacts can enter stable channel
performanceBudgets: Install/update time and disk overhead budgets are recorded
websiteImpact: Installer/download CTA remains hidden or source-only until clean-host evidence passes

workItems.title: Resolve licensing, third-party notices, trademark, contribution, security, and support policy
workItems.rationale: The root uses a custom non-SPDX Spark Open License while some subprojects and the website say MIT/open source; no complete THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES/package license set exists; release/security wording assumes a 1.0 line with no tag.
implementationScope: Obtain legal review and decide open-source versus source-available positioning
Use one accurate license claim everywhere
Add SPDX identifiers/headers where appropriate
Generate THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and ship required license texts
Document trademark/naming and DCO/CLA decision
Align supported-version/security-response/support policy with actual releases
Add license-compliance CI
acceptanceCriteria: Every distributed dependency/file has an identified license and fulfilled notice obligation
Website terminology matches reviewed classification
Packages include root license, notices, and required third-party texts
Security/support policy names actually published versions/channels
Legal/maintainer sign-off is release evidence
websiteImpact: Replace open-source/MIT language with reviewed classification; legal page links exact commit
risks: Attempting to infer legal classification without counsel

workItems.title: Repair and enforce deterministic repository documentation generation
workItems.rationale: Wiki Sync, Flowchart, and Codebase Stats are stale; update-all has an API-doc control-flow bug; docs-only changes bypass engine CI; counts and indexes disagree across files.
implementationScope: Fix API-doc check/regeneration control flow
Emit structured health JSON instead of parsing colored output
Make docs catalog own include/exclude/section/route overrides
Generate API pages during publication
Repair relative source links rather than website-only aliases
Validate every route/heading/source/image link
Remove docs path-ignore from readiness validation
acceptanceCriteria: docs/update-all-docs.sh check is green
Clean regeneration has no diff
Every doc route/source/heading/image resolves
Counts are generated once
A stale generator or broken link blocks CI
performanceBudgets: Full documentation generation completes within publication timeout
websiteImpact: Docs routes and search come from the live site-data bundle; stale state is explicit
risks: Generated docs hiding real source-link defects

workItems.title: Publish the repository-synchronized site-data bundle and complete public framing
workItems.rationale: The existing site checks in a 22 MB generated snapshot and hardcodes capabilities, counts, paths, CI runs, maturity rules, learning tracks, community status, and wording that can drift after Working moves.
implementationScope: Generate exact-SHA content/readiness/metrics/handoff/docs/search/page bundle
Publish to dedicated site-data branch after exact tested Working SHA
Publish blocked state after failed CI instead of leaving previous commit current
Use hash-addressed snapshots and switch latest last
Retain current plus two previous snapshots
Validate schema/hash/size at site runtime
Cache five minutes with stale-while-revalidate and label current/syncing/blocked/stale/unavailable
Move all mutable site wording and claims into repository data
Remove checked-in generated corpus after live parity
acceptanceCriteria: Repository-only wording/status/doc change appears on existing site without Sites checkpoint
Displayed SHA equals the bundle/evidence SHA
Failed same-commit CI changes site to blocked
Every mutable metric/capability/quick-start/learning/readiness/roadmap claim comes from bundle
Malformed/oversize/hash-invalid bundles are rejected
Fallback is visibly stale/unavailable
All docs routes/search/source links resolve
websiteImpact: This is the website synchronization implementation
risks: Claiming GitHub Actions can deploy Sites; it cannot
Serving an old fallback as current
outOfScope: Automatic Sites application-code deployment; layout/forum changes still use checkpointing
definitionOfDone: Owner-only site is redeployed once with the runtime
